name: Geo Targetly Geo Bar
author: geotargetly

sections.description:
Geo Bar lets you display notification bars to website visitors based on their country, state/region, city, lat-long radius, or IP address.

Use it to promote local offers, deliver regional messages, or direct users to location-specific pages, all without disrupting the browsing experience.

Each bar can contain custom text and an optional button, and can be styled to match your site. Choose from Small, Medium, or Big sizes (auto-adjusts font, padding, line-height) and control colors, fonts, and button presence per location.

You can also define scheduling rules – show bars on specific days, times, and time zones. Create multiple geo-targeted bars and manage them all with ease.

Made by Geo Targetly, this plugin is ideal for subtle but powerful location-based messaging.

  • Paid account is required – see pricing
  • 14-day free trial – no credit card needed

Features

  • Show notification bars by country, region, city, radius, or IP
  • Customize text, colors, font size, button, and bar placement
  • Choose bar size: Small (10px), Medium (13px), or Big (16px)
  • Create multiple geo bars with separate targeting rules
  • Schedule bars by day, hour, and the visitor’s timezone
  • An optional call-to-action button with a link
  • Display at the top or bottom of the page
  • Lightweight script – no coding required

Detailed docs can be found below

  • Overview https://geotargetly.com/geo-bar
  • Quick Start Guide https://help.geotargetly.com/en/articles/2158835-geobar-quick-start-guide
  • Docs https://help.geotargetly.com/en/collections/738535-geo-bars

Support

  • Live chat at Geo Targetly

External services

This plugin connects to an external endpoint via the domain https://g1980843351.co to load and run a script that powers its core
functionality, as outlined previously in the description.

It sends the user’s location each time the plugin is loaded. This is necessary to determine and customize the plugin’s
behavior based on the user’s geographical context.

This service is provided by Geo Targetly – Terms of Use,
Privacy Policy.
